items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: Try to play along with Maynard Ferguson and I’m going, “They don’t even have the fingerings in the book for this, so how am I supposed to do this?”

ctx.x: Okay. You must have not been a person who was afraid to take a chance, to basically improvise?

No. I didn’t learn by reading music. Because even though I started in the public schools you know that was sort of fundamentally [scats] and but my neighbor was a bass player. My back neighbor where I would climb over the fence and he had a little jazz group that he would rehearse. He was like an engineer at Sperry Gyroscope out on Long Island. He played bass. Genius. He was telling me about how they were working on the gyroscopes that would send the rockets up and stuff. I mean he was great. But my dad said to…
